title: Cursor Cuts Prices Amid AI Dev Tokenomics Reckoning
excerpt: Cursor's aggressive price cuts and new enterprise spend controls signal the end of the 'move fast and burn tokens' era in AI-assisted development. This market maturation moment presents opportunities for security and testing teams to implement discipline-driven practices.
post_draft:
What happens when AI dev tools stop burning money?

The "move fast and break things" era just hit a hard ceiling. Cursor's price cuts and new spend controls aren't just business moves—they're a wake-up call that AI-assisted development is entering a maturity phase.

For security and testing teams, this is huge. It means the chaotic era of unbounded token consumption is ending. Teams can finally implement real cost discipline without feeling like they're falling behind.

Better pricing models create space for better practices. When budgets tighten, governance improves. When governance improves, security improves.

This shift rewards organizations that built discipline-driven testing and security practices early. It punishes those still chasing every shiny AI feature without guardrails.
